benefit_text: The scheme offers low premiums. Farmers pay up to 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops. The government subsidises the rest, and in North‑Eastern States, Jammu, Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh it pays the whole premium. It covers natural disasters, pests, diseases, post‑harvest losses and localised calamities, and processes claims within two months after harvest.
who_can_apply: All farmers, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers, who grow notified crops in notified areas can apply. Applicants must have an insurable interest in the crops, a valid land ownership certificate or land tenure agreement, and must be the cultivator or sharecropper on the insured land. Applications should be made within two weeks of the sowing season start.
documents: Passport‑sized photograph, identity proof such as Aadhaar or voter ID, address proof like electricity bill, evidence of land records such as land possession certificate, and a declaration about the crop sown.
how_to_apply: Visit the official PMFBY website and click Farmer Corner, then Guest Farmer to register. Fill in personal, residential, ID and bank details, and submit the form. Log in with your mobile number, fill the application form, upload the documents and submit. Choose Pay Later or make payment, then track the status online.
